DAPTUP_HOOK_ENABLED.description: Whether Daptup gathers and shows information on each 'apt-get/aptitude/cupt update' invocation. Possible values: "n" (no), "y" (yes). (reused from existing: y|n enum)

DAPTUP_SHOW_CHANGES_IN_POST.description: Whether to show changes after updating the lists (in --post call). Possible values: "n" (no), "y" (yes). (reused from existing: y|n enum)

DAPTUP_CHECK_FOR_OUTDATED_PACKAGES.description: Enable check for outdated packages (preparing long ago, with newer candidates available). Possible values: "n" (no), "y" (yes). (reused from existing: y|n enum)

DAPTUP_PACKAGES_WATCH_FOR.description: Space-separated list of package names or regex patterns to watch (even if not installed). Regexes may not use ^ or $. (reused from existing)

DAPTUP_MINIMAL_DAY_COUNT_TREATING_OUTDAT.description: Minimum age (in days) for a package to be treated as 'outdated'. (reused from existing)

DAPTUP_USE_COLOR.description: Use colored output. Possible values: "n" (no), "y" (yes). (reused from existing: y|n enum)

DAPTUP_NEW_INCLUDE_DESCRIPTION.description: Include short descriptions when building list of available packages. Possible values: "n" (no), "y" (yes). (reused from existing: y|n enum)

DAPTUP_DISABLE_COLUMNS.description: Disable column output (pass --disable-columns to aptitude). Possible values: "n" (no), "y" (yes). Only effective with newer aptitude versions. (reused from existing: y|n enum)

DAPTUP_NEW_DISPLAY_FORMAT.description: Format string passed to aptitude for new packages changes output. See aptitude docs. (reused from existing)

DAPTUP_NEW_DISPLAY_WIDTH.description: Maximum line width for aptitude output of new package changes (requires aptitude). (reused from existing)

DAPTUP_WATCH_DISPLAY_FORMAT.description: Format string passed to aptitude for watched packages changes output. See aptitude docs. (reused from existing)

DAPTUP_WATCH_DISPLAY_WIDTH.description: Maximum line width for aptitude output of watched package changes (requires aptitude). (reused from existing)
